title: Complementary Boolean probabilities
statement: Let $n$ be a positive integer and let $w:\\operatorname{Fin}(n)\\to\\{\\mathrm{false},\\mathrm{true}\\}$ be a Boolean-valued function. The uniform probabilities that $w(i)$ is false and that $w(i)$ is true sum to $1$.
hypotheses_covered: $w$ is a function from $\\operatorname{Fin}(n)$ to the Boolean values
